name: fix-timezone-dependent-test
description: Use when a test passes on one machine and fails on another, or changes with the time of day.
---

# Fix a timezone-dependent test

1. Reproduce with `TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati npm test` and `TZ=America/Los_Angeles npm test`.
2. Find code that builds a local `Date` or reads the clock.
3. Replace it with an explicit instant or pass the clock in.
4. Add a test just before and just after midnight.

# Write a commit message

Read `git diff --staged`. Subject: imperative, under 72 characters. Body: why the change is needed, not a list of edited files.

# Release notes

List commits with `git log <last-tag>..HEAD --oneline`. Group them under Added, Fixed and Changed; drop merge commits and chores that users never see.

assets.name: pr-reviewer
assets.description: Reviews a pull request for correctness and edge cases; reports findings, never edits code.
assets.content:
---
name: pr-reviewer
description: Reviews a pull request for correctness and edge cases; reports findings, never edits code.
tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash
---

You review pull requests. Read the diff, then the surrounding code it touches. Report only problems you can point to a line for, ordered by severity, each with the input that triggers it. Do not edit files.
